subject: Kickoff: worst-case recall training for long-tail classification
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kickoff for the non-decomposable objectives effort. Our NeurIPS 2021 release implements worst-case recall maximization (Algorithm 1) using a logit-adjusted cost-sensitive loss, with three baselines in the box: standard ERM, the balanced logit-adjusted loss, and a re-weighted cost-sensitive loss.

Why it matters: data-platforms customers with long-tail label distributions keep discovering that average accuracy hides catastrophic recall on rare classes. "No class left behind" as a training objective is a sellable, auditable guarantee.

Deliverables: (1) reproduce the paper's results on the CIFAR-10/100 long-tail datasets, (2) validate on one internal long-tail workload, (3) integrate the loss into the platform trainer with sane defaults. Milestones: repro by end of April, internal validation by mid-June, integration readout by 06-29.

One planning note: our internal workload's tfrecords live in Corpus, so migration timing affects us — details with your resourcing pass.

Dmitri
